_comment: Git-tracked fleet host-identity map (CAI-RESP-1436). canonical label -> known aliases (the values socket.gethostname() may return for this physical host across DHCP/network flaps). This ONE reviewed artifact is BOTH the boot source for FLEET_HOST_ID AND the runtime alias-resolver. VALUES are owned/verified by the host-provisioning owner (orch-console) against a verified provisioning source before the floor gate signs. To pin a host durably, its boot exports FLEET_HOST_ID=<canonical>; alias-match is only a mid-rollout/edge resilience net and logs that the host is unpinned.

Sheikhs-Mini.note: Mac Mini. macOS auto-reset the DHCP-derived hostname to 'Sheikhs-Mac-mini' (LocalHostName) / 'Sheikhs-Mac-mini.local' on 2026-09-20 (bus 41834); canonical fleet label is Sheikhs-Mini.
